summary: The audit checks COMM 1 (or 1B), 106 and 108, one course from each area, and COMM electives to make 35 units, plus an introductory statistics course that does not count toward the 35. Every course needs a C- or better, and every COMM course a letter grade unless it is only offered S/NC. You check by hand the 2.0 GPA and any pre-approved course from another department, of which at most 5 units count.

program.why: Grading: "Only courses with a C- or above grade count towards the minor."

totals.label: Statistics course (not part of the 35 units)
totals.why: "The statistics course does not count toward the 35 units to complete the Communication minor."

KWPBh5Cf.why: Notes: "The statistics course does not count toward the 35 units to complete the Communication minor. In addition to the three core courses and the statistics course, students must take one course in each of the two areas specified below." Elective notes: "The remainder of the 35 required units may be filled with any elective communication courses or a combination of communication courses and up to five units from a list of pre-approved courses in other departments (see link on the department's website)." The core, the two areas and the electives are grouped under the 35-unit floor; the statistics course (ov-stats) sits outside it. The pre-approved list is not in the Bulletin, so those courses and petitioned ones are moved in by hand. Grading: "Communication minors must receive a letter grade for all communication courses unless they are offered only for satisfactory/no credit (S/NC)."
